WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

2. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.

3. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.

4. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.

5. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.

6. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.

9. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

12. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Detailed drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

7. A — CPU

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

10. D — Information and Communication Technology

11. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
